leakage_signals: Missing priority tradeoff between museum convenience and dinner convenience
Missing importance of breakfast and in-room refrigerator/coffeemaker
No stated need for the quiet-room or parking details added in choice B
verdict.rationale: Museum District Hampton best supports the museum-oriented stay and provides breakfast plus confirmed in-room coffee and refrigerator, while City Flats is cheaper and closer to the family dinner. Both appear compatible with parking once, and the query does not establish whether museum proximity and room amenities outweigh price and dinner proximity. Homewood conflicts with the preference to avoid additional driving or rideshares, and waiting for the restaurant reservation is unnecessary given refundable options.
